ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick with Alexa Voice Remote, streaming media player - Previous Generation; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a Fire TV Stick 4K Max bundle, so this older stick adds little for me.

ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The larger display interests me, but I just bought a Show 5 and its stand, so I would pass this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo (2nd Generation) - Smart speaker with Alexa and Dolby processing - Charcoal Fabric; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: With my newer Echo Dot and Show 5, I do not currently need another Alexa speaker.
ItemID: NA; Title: Amazon Basics HDMI Cable, 18Gbps High-Speed, 4K@60Hz, 2160p, Ethernet Ready, 10 Foot, Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It fits my TV equipment, but I would only buy it when I need a longer cable.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire 7 tablet, 7" display, 16 GB, (2019 release), Black; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am focused on home electronics and computer accessories, with no current need for a small tablet.
ItemID: NA; Title: Panasonic ErgoFit Wired Earbuds, In-Ear Headphones with Microphone and Call Controller, Ergonomic Custom-Fit Earpieces (S/M/L), 3.5mm Jack for Phones and Laptops - RP-TCM125-A (Blue); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not looking for wired earbuds, and I would need to check whether my devices have a compatible jack.
ItemID: NA; Title: Logitech M510 Wireless Computer Mouse – Comfortable Shape with USB Unifying Receiver, with Back/Forward Buttons and Side-to-Side Scrolling, Dark Gray; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: I have bought several mice, so I would inspect it, but my history does not establish a current replacement need.
ItemID: NA; Title: Seagate Backup Plus Portable 5TB External Hard Drive HDD – Red USB 3.0 for PC Laptop and Mac, 2 Months Adobe CC Photography (STDR5000103); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose it for portable backups alongside my older 4TB desktop drive; the extra capacity and portability appeal to me.
ItemID: NA; Title: SABRENT 4 Port USB 2.0 Data Hub with Individual LED lit Power Switches [Charging NOT Supported] for Mac & PC (HB-UMLS); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Individual switches would be handy for peripherals, but my existing USB 3.0 hub makes this a low priority.
